incident-bot: PagerDuty autotrigger PD-8907 | Service: inference-gateway-prod | Symptom: HTTP 5xx rate spike (>4% 5xx over 5m) | Metric: 5xx rate 6.2% | Links: https://pagerduty/PD-8907, https://grafana.local/d/inf-gw/5xx
pagerduty: Incident PD-8907 automatically created and notified on-call rotation
alice: acked on-call. Taking ownership. Starting triage. @ben @rohit FYI
ben: Looking at ingress stats — envoy instances in eu-west1 showing lots of 502/504, reasons: connection_reset / upstream_timeout. sample trace id=abc123 -> upstream model-serving-2 pod showed repeated restarts
rohit: I see a recent config push at 02:12 that tightened envoy-rate-limiter (tenant burst cap). Errors started ~02:18. Rolling back that config now.
deploy-bot: Rollback triggered for envoy-rate-limiter config, rollout id r-20260315-17 — starting gradual rollback
alice: Also seeing client retry storm in nginx access logs — retries amplify errors. Short-term mitigation: disable external rate-limiter for 30m and map 429->503 to cut aggressive retries
support-maya: CS update: ~14 customers reported 502s (mostly free-tier/prod test accounts). Tickets created: #3940, #3941. Sending standard status note to affected customers.
ben: quick logs/snippet:
> curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
> * Connected to api.redwood.ai (1.2.3.4)
> < HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
k8s: pod/model-serving-2 (node g4-12) restarted 3x in 10m window — OOM not obvious, logs show upstream connection reset
rohit: scaling model-serving pool +2 replicas, increased ephemeral burst capacity on Dedicated routing for 10m while rollback completes
alice: Rollback finished — deploy-bot reports 100% rolled back at 3501234605. Watching metrics
pagerduty: PD-8907 acknowledged by alice at 3501234578
incident-bot: Autopage auto-suppression enabled for noisy PD alerts. Notifying next SRE rotation for continued checks
alice: post-rollback 5xx down to 0.9% over 5m. Keeping mitigations for 20m. Creating follow-up task INC-8907-postmortem and assigning to rohit
support-maya: customers notified, offering token credits where sessions failed. No escalations requested.
rohit: root-cause draft: faulty rate-limiter config introduced during canary -> upstream backpressure -> client retry amplification -> transient 5xx spike. Action items: stricter rollout gating, automated spike-detection rollback, add synthetic checks for envoy-rate-limiter behavior
alice: handing off monitoring to ben for night watch. Ben, please escalate to infra lead @carla if 5xx >2% for >10m
ben: taking handoff — will watch for 2 hours.
carla: on-call ack. Ping me if recurrence or customer-impact broadens
alice: marking incident resolved in Slack. End time 3501234720 :white_check_mark:
